subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 17, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has just received another crucial fine-tuning, building on the recent introduction of per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest ISO images, which significantly boosts the reliability and efficiency of our release process. This change is now reflected in our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html, where you can find detailed information about the latest developments in our project.

Development
The development team has been working tirelessly to ensure that our release process is as robust as possible, and the latest improvements are a testament to this effort. With the introduction of per-pipeline staging directories, we can avoid publish races between concurrent builds, making our pipeline more efficient and reliable. You can learn more about our development process and how to get involved on our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Community
The community has been actively engaged in discussions about the latest security updates and stable kernel sets, with the 7.1.10 and 6.18.46 kernels being made available recently. We encourage all users to stay up-to-date with the latest security patches and kernel releases, and our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html provides guidance on how to do so. Additionally, you can find information about the latest Emacs release, version 31.1, and how to install it on your AcreetionOS system. If you're looking for the latest ISO image, you can find it at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html.
